description: This file defines functions and types for processing Chrome MCP snapshot data, including normalization, filtering, and conversion to ARIA nodes, as well as snapshot building with optional truncation.

classes.name: ChromeMcpSnapshotNode
classes.description: Type representing a node in the Chrome MCP snapshot with optional id, role, name, value, description, and children.

methods.name: normalizeRole
methods.description: Normalizes the role string of a node, trimming and converting to lowercase, defaulting to 'generic'.

methods.name: normalizeString
methods.description: Converts various types to a trimmed string or undefined if not applicable.

methods.name: escapeQuoted
methods.description: Escapes backslashes and double quotes in a string for safe inclusion in quoted strings.

methods.name: shouldIncludeNode
methods.description: Determines if a node should be included based on role, name, and options such as interactivity and compactness.

methods.name: shouldCreateRef
methods.description: Decides if a reference should be created for a node based on its role and name.

methods.name: createDuplicateTracker
methods.description: Creates a tracker object to manage duplicate references.

methods.name: registerRef
methods.description: Registers a reference in the tracker, updating counts and duplicates, and returns the occurrence number if duplicate.

methods.name: flattenChromeMcpSnapshotToAriaNodes
methods.description: Flattens a Chrome MCP snapshot into an array of ARIA nodes with a limit on output size.

methods.name: buildAiSnapshotFromChromeMcpSnapshot
methods.description: Builds a textual snapshot from the Chrome MCP snapshot, with optional truncation and reference tracking.
